blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court is optimistic that the Supreme Court would immediately decide on the petitions challenging its decision to reduce the number of votes needed to convict — or acquit — Vice President Sara Duterte. “Yes, that’s the expectation of our presiding officer [Sen. Francis Escudero] and the whole impeachment court. That’s why he also mentioned that he doesn’t want any issue to crop up beyond 2027,” said impeachment court spokesperson Reginald Tongol in an interview on radio dzBB on Sunday.
